s1.syndrome_frame: Acute onset of neurological deficits with reduced consciousness, aphasia, and urinary incontinence in an immunocompromised patient
salient_findings: Multiple enhancing nodular white matter lesions on brain CT scan
key_facts: 60-year-old woman
Recently diagnosed with HIV
Not yet on antiretroviral therapy
One-day history of reduced consciousness, aphasia, and urinary incontinence
Two-day history of dry cough, drenching night sweats, and weight loss
No fever, headache, neck stiffness, visual disturbances, photophobia, or seizures
Wasted appearance with weight of 40 kg
Afebrile with blood pressure 120/74 mmHg, pulse 66 beats/min, and oxygen saturation 98% on room air
Glasgow Coma Scale score of 14/15 with dysarthria
CD4 count of 6 cells/mm^3
Positive serum cryptococcal antigen test with a titer of 1:320
